subject: Boundary, SIG/CAIQ asks & ISO scope clarification
messages:
From: Jae Park <jpark@acmeinc.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: auditor@3paudit.com
Date: Thu, 14 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Boundary, SIG/CAIQ asks & ISO scope clarification

Hi Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Acme's compliance team reviewed the materials and we have a couple of follow-ups before we kick off the SIG/CAIQ and ISO scoping work:

- For SIG: can you confirm which clusters/environments will be in-scope for our SIG review? Specifically: production HTTP endpoints only, or also staging/test that contain copies of telemetry?
- For ISO: Acme prefers ISO coverage to include customer-facing inference endpoints but we want to understand whether Redwood's private control plane or managed control plane is considered in-scope for evidence collection. Any diagram would help.
- Evidence asks: our auditor will request access review samples, KMS key rotation logs, and network segmentation diagrams. Can you confirm owners and an expected turnaround time for sample evidence?

I've attached the ACME_SIG_questions.pdf with the initial list. Our auditor (CC'd) will want to run a short intake call — do you have availability next week?

Appreciate your help,

Jae Park
Director, Security Assurance
Acme Inc.

Attachments: ACME_SIG_questions.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Jae Park <jpark@acmeinc.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, auditor@3paudit.com
Date: Thu, 14 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Boundary, SIG/CAIQ asks & ISO scope clarification

Hi Jae — thanks for the clear list. High level answers and next steps below; I'll upload the supporting artifacts to the shared drive after the thread.

1) Scope (SIG/CAIQ): Our recommended in-scope set for Acme's review is:
   - Production inference endpoints (regional public endpoints you hit via API keys)
   - Dedicated tenant data stores (if you opt for a dedicated deployment)
   - Exclude ephemeral developer/test clusters that do not persist customer data

   NOTE: If you plan to use Redwood Private (customer-managed VPC), we consider the private control plane "customer-managed" for audit purposes but will still provide the artifacts you asked for (network diagrams, KMS integration notes, and interface-level logs). See attached iso-scope-diagram.png for a proposed boundary diagram.

2) SIG / CAIQ timeline: We can produce a first-pass SIG-v3-responses.xlsx within 10 business days once we have the finalized in-scope list and confirmation of whether Acme needs staging included.

3) Evidence owners & samples:
   - Access reviews & IAM sampling: Rishi (rishi_malhotra) — 7 business days for sample exports
   - KMS/HSM rotation logs & key metadata: Infra security (via product team) — 10 business days
   - Network segmentation + routing diagrams: Platform architecture — 5 business days

Proposed intake call slots: Mon 11/18 10:00-11:00 PT or Tue 11/19 15:00-16:00 PT. Please confirm what works.

Action items: I'll attach SIG-v3-responses.xlsx draft, the iso-scope-diagram.png, and a short mutual action plan link.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Compliance Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-v3-responses.xlsx; iso-scope-diagram.png
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Boundary, SIG/CAIQ asks & ISO scope clarification

Vanessa — tagging a couple of quick clarifications from the sales/eng side before we lock timelines:

- For evidence sampling windows, the auditor typically prefers a 90-day window for change-control and access reviews. We should propose standard windows and note any exceptions (e.g., newly onboarded tenants).
- For staging data: if Acme wants staging in scope and it contains anonymized copies of telemetry, that will increase the evidence set and push estimates by ~5 business days.

Rishi — can you confirm if we have a runbook for pulling sanitized access review samples and whether that needs engineering support? If so, we should reserve a small eng slot in the first week.

Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Boundary, SIG/CAIQ asks & ISO scope clarification

Marissa / Vanessa — quick update on the evidence pulls:

- Access review exports: we have an automated report that can produce CSVs for a 90/30/7 day window. I can produce a 90-day sample set by 11/25. Owner: Identity ops (me).
- KMS/HSM: rotation metadata is in our key manager’s audit stream; we can export rotation events and policy IDs. Note: for Redwood Private with customer-managed KMS, we'll need Acme's help to export rotation logs from their KMS — we can provide the query.
- Logging & trace retention: default 365 days for control plane telemetry, 90 days for ephemeral inference traces unless customer asks for longer retention.

Propose a brief dry-run intake with the auditor on Tue 11/30 09:30 PT to validate sample format and avoid rework. I attached an evidence_list_sample.csv that shows the column layout we'll send.

Rishi
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: evidence_list_sample.csv
From: Jae Park <jpark@acmeinc.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, auditor@3paudit.com
Date: Mon, 18 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Boundary, SIG/CAIQ asks & ISO scope clarification

Thanks all — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. Confirming the following: 

- Acme will scope ONLY production endpoints (no staging) for the SIG review to keep the initial intake tight.
- We accept the proposed 90-day sampling window.
- Intake/dry-run call confirmed for Tue 11/30 09:30 PT — Auditor will send dial-in.

Next asks for Redwood: please upload the SIG-v3-draft workbook and the mutual action plan to the shared Drive by COB Mon 11/22 so our compliance team can preview before the dry-run. Also include any sample queries for KMS exports for the private deployment case.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to the call.

Jae Park
Director, Security Assurance
Acme Inc.
